title: בחירת העולם החזותי לאתר של ShoobyD
question: ההגרלה בחרה ב'פלניספרה', מפת כוכבים מסתובבת. אפשר לשמור אותה, לבחור חלופה, או להגריל מחדש.

options.label: פלניספרה: השמיים של שובידי
options.lineage: The rotating star wheel (planisphere) every amateur astronomer owns: a printed sky card turning behind a mask with an oval horizon window
options.thesis: Baruch is the pole star at the rivet; his interests are the date ring, and turning it brings projects into the window as constellations.
materials: saturated yellow mask with an oval window
hand-drawn constellation figures in his own line
options.viewport: One planisphere fills the screen. At the rivet: name, ShoobyD, one line of who he is. The ring of interests is draggable or turned with arrow keys, and projects appear as stars.
options.risk: Rotating navigation hides content, so a plain readable catalog must always sit beneath it. Without his own drawing line it slides into a generic 'space theme'.

raised.raise: Every project gets a catalog designation (SD-01, SD-02… like Messier numbers), so the sky reads as an index, not decoration.
Under the wheel, every project repeats as an identical catalog entry, one unit and one format, scanned in a single sweep.
One surface, one gesture: turning moves the whole sky together, and nothing on the face animates by itself.
A still state: with no interaction or with reduced motion, the wheel rests on 'tonight' and is fully readable.

options.label: עמוד הקומיקס של שבת
options.lineage: Sunday newspaper strips, in the tradition of Calvin and Hobbes' broken-panel Sundays
options.thesis: Baruch introduces himself as the narrator of his own Sunday strip; every project is a panel he walks you into.
options.viewport: A big title panel with a drawn self-portrait and a speech balloon saying who he is; the next row of panels already shows projects mid-gag.
options.risk: The most familiar choice for a personal site with a drawing habit. It needs his own drawings or it reads as clip art, and Hebrew hand-lettering fonts are thin.

options.label: מעטפת גזרה
options.lineage: Home sewing pattern envelopes and their tissue
options.thesis: ShoobyD as a sewing pattern: views A/B/C on the front (developer, musician, illustrator), projects as numbered pieces inside.
options.viewport: The envelope front with three drawn figures labelled A/B/C and the pattern number; the parts table on the side is the navigation.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: the 'views' carry the polymath and the back's tables carry the project list. Holds product clarity, loses identification, because sewing isn't one of his worlds.
options.risk: A borrowed craft: close to DIY but not his, so it can read as a costume.

options.label: אתר יפני דחוס
options.thesis: Everything ShoobyD does on one packed screen: dozens of ruled modules, each a project or interest with a small red tab.
options.viewport: A strip about him on top, then a dense mosaic of 20+ modules of projects, interests and links, all visible at once.
options.case: Holds product clarity, since every project is visible at a glance. Loses identification: 'me first' becomes one module among many.
options.risk: Small Hebrew text strains the eye, and it can feel like a shop rather than a person.

options.label: מסוף חללית
options.thesis: You query the ship's computer about ShoobyD and it answers in green capitals.
options.viewport: A typed query line and an answer printing letter by letter.
options.case: Fuses poorly: Hebrew in monospaced capitals fails, and it is exactly the cheap nostalgia he ruled out.
options.kept: Every zone is labelled with a systematic code, so every project now carries a catalog designation.

options.label: גשר מדי VU
options.thesis: Every interest is a needle leaning into the red.
options.viewport: A row of meters, one per interest.
options.case: Fuses poorly: it measures intensity and doesn't introduce a person or show projects.
options.risk: A gimmick that ties everything to music only.
options.kept: Identical units repeated as the row's ruler, so the project catalog becomes one uniform repeated entry.

options.label: אברו: צבע צף
options.thesis: The page is a pigment bath the visitor combs.
options.viewport: A pigment bath covering the screen.
options.case: Fuses poorly: there is no place for a name, a bio or a project list.
options.kept: One surface, one gesture: the whole wheel turns together.

options.label: חתך אור יום
options.thesis: A ray of sun crossing the rooms of his life.
options.viewport: One long building section with a beam of light.
options.case: Fuses poorly: architecture is not one of his worlds.
options.risk: A clever metaphor nobody identifies with.
options.kept: A still 'noon' state that reads without interaction, so the wheel rests on 'tonight'.

canonCard.label: הסטנדרט של הקטגוריה
canonCard.thesis: A developer portfolio played straight: name, one-line role, short bio, project grid, contact, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A large headline, a line about him, two buttons, and a row of project cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any other portfolio by design, the 'sterile / template' look you ruled out.
